title: CTW-adviser · Phase 3 preview (PR #11 unmerged)
description: Read-only inspection of PR #11: assembled unit evidence, explained attributes and conditional passives, scoped attacks, linked options, provenance and coverage. This preview is under review before merge.

unit_profiles.description: 2,379 distinct profiles representing 2,409 original unit keys. unit_keys lists equivalent keys; unit_aliases resolves each original key. faction_name is a list; restrictions and source locators remain in unit_availability (3,181 records).

unit_availability.description: Original faction/subculture-qualified availability, restrictions, notes and provenance. Shared inclusion does not transfer recruitment permissions.

unit_aliases.description: All 2,409 original unit keys mapped to canonical profiles. Key-only consolidation requires identical profile fields and linked combat evidence; availability and provenance remain keyed to the original identity.

unit_roster_records.description: Lossless reconstruction of the 3,181 original source roster records; repeated combat statistics are stored once in unit_profiles.

coverage_gaps.description: Known limits in the retained native definitions; these are not inferred combat effects.

source_files.description: Locked source paths and byte hashes used to build this snapshot.

find_units.title: Find units by name
find_units.description: Search by part of a name. Click a unit name to inspect its assembled attributes, passive effects, conditions, attacks and provenance. Phase 3 preview from unmerged PR #11.
find_units.sql: select unit_key, unit_name, unit_keys, faction_name, tactical_category, entity_count, total_hp, armour, melee_attack, melee_defence, weapon_base_damage, weapon_ap_damage, speed, multiplayer_cost from unit_profiles where unit_name like '%' || :name || '%' order by unit_name, unit_key

description_html: Open assembled unit evidence · Inspect Kroxigor · Unmerged PR #11
